externalLoad.noteKo: 외부 앱과 모니터 프로세스의 CPU 사용이 있었다. 14개 논리 CPU에서 측정 전후 load average를 기록했다. 전환 전 부하 원자료는 없어 부하를 같게 맞췄다고 주장하지 않는다.

ratioDefinition: after / before; below 1 means lower measured value. Zero / zero is represented as 1. Null server statistics mean not applicable for Yjs.
limits: Only the existing single-user typing/paste core trace and local client insert benchmark are covered.
JSON ours and binary Yjs differ in wire and snapshot encoding; cross-engine byte ratios are not format-neutral.
Client excludes network, rendering, commit and subscriber model-update cost.
Remote model-event subscription, long-duration, multi-user, large tables and browser latency are outside this measurement.
Single-run timing, max and heap vary with runtime and external load; no broad performance equivalence claim from one run.
One baseline run and two after runs do not establish statistical equivalence or causality. No elapsed-time acceptance threshold was defined for this migration.
Some maximum times increased, especially 100k ours remote and repeat Yjs remote; results do not establish every metric is equal or faster.

All client observed p95 values here are below 2ms; this excludes browser rendering, network, commit, model-update callback cost and remote event handling, so it does not establish editor latency acceptance.
Presence selection-range work did not modify sources during these runs; this comparison covers the migration source receipt only.
